rv.q: Mitchell's performance is the production's greatest strength.

Online comedian Derek Mitchell (aka @derekscottmitchell or @letsdoubledutch) travels back to 2007. Illinois and introduces 15-year-old Eliot. Armed with skinny jeans, skater shoes, and a prominent emo fringe, he struggles. Equally bullied at school as he is ignored at home, Eliot wades through life with his guard up.
This wonderfully original production is both enormously entertaining and genuinely affecting.
